claim_text: Celebrities who did these things to children will fall over dead, and a new venereal disease will come that is worse than AIDS or herpes combined, presenting as a groin infection in men and women.
quote: a terrible groin infection on men and women
falsify_match: A newly identified sexually transmitted infection with worse outcomes than HIV, and a run of sudden deaths among people accused of child abuse.
falsify_miss: No new pathogen of that severity is identified. The judgment half is untestable because he does not say how the deaths would be distinguished from ordinary ones.
